corpus.exclusionRule: Only Markdown documents under docs/ are governed corpus members. Root-level repository instruction files (README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) are deliberately excluded: they are repository operating instructions whose governing content is already canonical within docs/ (see ADR-0001). Non-Markdown files under docs/ (none exist today) would be excluded as non-document artifacts.
